name: Villa Rashmi
description:
Villa Rashmi is a one-of-a-kind 100-year old heritage villa in Mumbai with over 50 rooms, located on a dead-end road in the heart of the suburb of Malad. The villa itself is a part of a larger Bhadran Bhuvan Estate owned solely by Shri Haresh M. Patel, who was born there.

Villa Rashmi has been carefully restored to its original state as when it was built prior to 1920, with authentic Victorian antique furniture, high wooden sloping ceilings, spacious and bright rooms with heritage tiles, private balconies, large verandahs, courtyard etcetera, but fitted with modern amenities for today’s comfort.

The architecture and ambience of the heritage villa has been appreciated by creative directors, artists, photographers, celebrities etc.

There’s a small area for yoga workouts and stretching, making it a great spot to relax and exercise.

featured_reviews.name: Smitha Renny
featured_reviews.review_text:
I walked about 15 min from my place to reach this beautiful and serene haven. Rich in foliage, this park is a favourite among not just the neighbours, but people living far too.

There's a dedicated jogging path which offers you a soft landing.. ideal for jogging... There are several exercise machine too which help you exercise without going to expensive gyms... Also offering the serene and lush green environment which is so recommended for exercise and workout.

Once you've sweated it out, you can relax and cool down on the several swings that are installed all around the park. Yoga enthusiasts have a dedicated area which is cemented and has a concrete canopy offering you a really cool and breezy surrounding to get relaxed with yogic exercises and postures. The huge Banyan trees in the central area of the park provide a thicket of cool space where you can relax, read your favourite book, listen to music or discourses or even hear a narrated story on your smart device.

The small and artificial lake provides soothing comfort(though the water is in need of treatment and regular circulation). The bridge over the lake too is a picturesque sight.

In all, its truly a place to exercise your body and compose your mind.
I came back energized and yet calm.. Do take out time and visit... You won't regret it.

🙏 Papal Audience

🙏 Notre-Dame Cathedral
🙏 Visits to many sacred churches and holy sites that deepened our faith and filled our hearts with gratitude.

🌍 Along the way, we were also blessed to experience some of Europe's most beautiful destinations:
🚢 Mediterranean Cruise from Barcelona to Rome
🚤 Water Bus ride through magical Venice
❄️ Mount Titlis and its breathtaking snow-covered peaks
💎 Swarovski Crystal World
🇵🇹 Lisbon's charming squares and streets
🇫🇷 The magnificent Eiffel Tower in Paris
📸 Countless picture-perfect moments and lifelong memories

What began as a pilgrimage became a journey of friendship, laughter, learning, prayer, and wonder. Every day brought a new blessing and a new adventure.

A heartfelt thank you to TKI Tours, our tour leaders, guides, and fellow pilgrims who made this experience so enjoyable and meaningful. The organization, care, and attention to detail ensured that we could focus on enjoying every moment.

As they say, we came back with more than souvenirs—we returned with grateful hearts, strengthened faith, wonderful friendships, and memories to cherish forever. ❤️

name: ZW Biodiversity Walks with Meehir Pawar
description: Embark on a guided journey through Mumbai's diverse ecosystems with Zoological Wisdom's Nature Walks, where every step reveals the city's hidden natural wonders. Led by an experienced field naturalist, Meehir Pawar, our tours explore the vibrant biodiversity of forests, wetlands, and coastal habitats. Discover the intricate lives of insects, birds, and plants through engaging, hands-on learning experiences designed for everyone from curious beginners to seasoned enthusiasts. We offer a unique blend of natural history, ecology, and observation, inviting you to connect with the wild side of Mumbai. Private and customized walks are also available.

featured_reviews.name: D H
featured_reviews.review_text:
A BREATH OF FRESH AIR!

It's a much required and appreciated recreational space for the community. Open to the public, there isn't anything as good as this space in the vicinity. Grateful for the management's work as it is a big relief to be able to spend some peaceful time amidst trees and greenery. Very well-maintained garden with something suitable for all ages.

Pros:
- Wheelchair accessible
- Well maintained garden with coconut, banana, bonsai and a wide variety of trees and flowering plants
- Nicely paved and maintained walking / jogging track
- Sand play area for kids with swings, slides, etc.
- Couple of swings for adults
- Grass area for picnic
- Drinking water facility with filtered and BMC water supply
- Clean, odourless restroom with 2 toilet stalls - 1 Indian and EWC each, 2 washbasins, 2 mirrors - 1 large at the basin and 1 full length at the entrance
- Beautifully lit with a warm ambience
- Long flight of stairs at the entrance which can double up for a good cardio
- Plenty of benches and seating areas to relax and rest
- Quite a few areas for doing yoga & exercises

Cons:
- Music is always playing on speakers.
From religious bhajans to retro Bollywood to remixed Punjabi songs.
People must listen to the music of their preference on their respective earphones. Everyone doesn't need to be subjected to it as it ruins the peaceful vibe of the space. It's a public place and this is a bit of an unpleasant experience.
- Very short track for walking/ jogging of barely 300m
- No soap in the restroom
- Too many mosquitoes during monsoon

review_photos.caption: Separate Wheelchair accessible entrance, Mural art on walls, Benches to relax & rest, Grass for picnic, yoga, etc., Long flight of stairs at entrance for cardio, Lots of coconut, banana and palm trees with a wide variety of flowering and bonsai plants, Play area for kids, Other area for exercises
Well-maintained and paved walking & jogging track. Barely 300m long yet it is nice. It would have been great if it was much longer.
Play area with slide, see-saw, merry-go-round, swing for kids
Grass area for picnic, yoga, relaxing, etc. Long flight of stairs at entrance for cardio.
Wide variety of trees and flowering plants. Palm, coconut, banana, Bonsai trees and many more.
Nicely created areas to do yoga, exercises, rest, etc
Very clean, hygienic and odourless restroom with 2 washbasins, mirror and 2 toilet stalls.
Very clean, hygienic Indian and EWC toilets. No soap available.

Right from arrival to departure, everything was perfectly organized. The hotels were excellent—especially The Royal Pita Maha in Ubud, which was absolutely stunning and serene. The entire itinerary was well-balanced with adventure, sightseeing, and relaxation. We especially enjoyed the Mount Batur Jeep Trek, the Ubud swing experience, and the breathtaking Nusa Penida tour.

All transfers were smooth, and the drivers were punctual and friendly. We didn’t have to worry about a thing—TripXOXO took care of every detail, making the whole experience stress-free.

One small tip for future travelers: If you’re planning to visit Gili Islands, either book the morning ferry or consider staying for two nights to enjoy the island better. The travel can be a bit tiring otherwise.

Highly recommend TripXOXO for anyone planning a trip to Bali!

featured_reviews.name: Joshua Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text: Built in 1800 by the North Salsette Society's local Taluka Board, this well was buried under debris and subsequent road developments, lost for years. It was rediscovered in 2018 with the efforts of local water conservationist Vincy Pareira and renovated in 2020 with the support of local corporator Tejasvee Ghosalkar. The mural sculpture depicting the culture and traditions of a typical East Indian village is designed by artists Sachin Waikar and Santosh Waikar.
